name: autozone/product
description: Get an AutoZone part by product ID with brand, part number, price, specifications, warranty, vehicle fitment and store availability.

store_id.description: Parameter defines the AutoZone store to get the in-store pickup availability for, shown as `in_store_pickup` (e.g., `4254` for 10633 US Hwy 290 E, Manor, TX). The store ID is the store number shown as Store # in AutoZone's store details.

product_id.description: Parameter defines the AutoZone product to get. The product ID is the number at the end of the product's page URL on AutoZone (e.g., `832327` for `https://www.autozone.com/p/duralast-gold-battery-24f-dlg/832327`).

vehicle_make.description: Parameter defines the make of the vehicle, as named on AutoZone (e.g., `Toyota`). Parameter requires `vehicle_year` and `vehicle_model` parameters to also be set.

vehicle_type.description: Parameter defines the type of the vehicle. It defaults to `car_truck` when `vehicle_year`, `vehicle_make`, and `vehicle_model` are set. Available options: `car_truck` - Car & Truck `motorcycle` - Motorcycle `recreational` - Recreational Parameter requires `vehicle_year`, `vehicle_make`, and `vehicle_model` parameters to also be set.

vehicle_year.description: Parameter defines the year of the vehicle to check the fitment of the product for (e.g., `2015`). Parameter requires `vehicle_make` and `vehicle_model` parameters to also be set.

vehicle_model.description: Parameter defines the model of the vehicle, as named on AutoZone (e.g., `Camry`). Parameter requires `vehicle_year` and `vehicle_make` parameters to also be set.

vehicle_token.description: Parameter defines the vehicle with the token of an AutoZone Search API search for it, from `search_information.vehicle.vehicle_token` or the `the API_link` of its results, without looking the vehicle up on AutoZone. Parameter can't be used together with `vehicle_year`, `vehicle_make`, `vehicle_model`, `vehicle_engine`, `vehicle_submodel`, and `vehicle_type` parameters.

vehicle_engine.description: Parameter defines the engine of the vehicle, as named on AutoZone (e.g., `4 Cylinders 2.5L GAS`). Parameter requires `vehicle_year`, `vehicle_make`, and `vehicle_model` parameters to also be set.

json_restrictor.description: Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

vehicle_submodel.description: Parameter defines the submodel of the vehicle, as named on AutoZone (e.g., `LE`). Without it, products that only fit some submodels have a `fitment: needs_more_info`. Parameter requires `vehicle_year`, `vehicle_make`, and `vehicle_model` parameters to also be set.

# AutoZone Product

Get an AutoZone part by product ID with brand, part number, price, specifications, warranty, vehicle fitment and store availability.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/autozone/product" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"product_id": "992113"}'
```

The result is returned in `outputs[0].data` as structured JSON.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `product_id` | string | Yes | Parameter defines the AutoZone product to get. The product ID is the number at the end of the product's page URL on AutoZone (e.g., `832327` for `https://www.autozone.com/p/duralast-gold-battery-24f-dlg/832327`). |
| `store_id` | string | No | Parameter defines the AutoZone store to get the in-store pickup availability for, shown as `in_store_pickup` (e.g., `4254` for 10633 US Hwy 290 E, Manor, TX). The store ID is the store number shown as Store # in AutoZone's store details. |
| `vehicle_year` | string | No | Parameter defines the year of the vehicle to check the fitment of the product for (e.g., `2015`). Parameter requires `vehicle_make` and `vehicle_model` parameters to also be set. |
| `vehicle_make` | string | No | Parameter defines the make of the vehicle, as named on AutoZone (e.g., `Toyota`). Parameter requires `vehicle_year` and `vehicle_model` parameters to also be set. |
| `vehicle_model` | string | No | Parameter defines the model of the vehicle, as named on AutoZone (e.g., `Camry`). Parameter requires `vehicle_year` and `vehicle_make` parameters to also be set. |
| `vehicle_engine` | string | No | Parameter defines the engine of the vehicle, as named on AutoZone (e.g., `4 Cylinders 2.5L GAS`). Parameter requires `vehicle_year`, `vehicle_make`, and `vehicle_model` parameters to also be set. |
| `vehicle_submodel` | string | No | Parameter defines the submodel of the vehicle, as named on AutoZone (e.g., `LE`). Without it, products that only fit some submodels have a `fitment: needs_more_info`. Parameter requires `vehicle_year`, `vehicle_make`, and `vehicle_model` pa |
| `vehicle_type` | string | No | Parameter defines the type of the vehicle. It defaults to `car_truck` when `vehicle_year`, `vehicle_make`, and `vehicle_model` are set. Available options: `car_truck` - Car & Truck `motorcycle` - Motorcycle `recreational` - Recreational Par |
| `vehicle_token` | string | No | Parameter defines the vehicle with the token of an AutoZone Search API search for it, from `search_information.vehicle.vehicle_token` or the `the API_link` of its results, without looking the vehicle up on AutoZone. Parameter can't be used  |
| `json_restrictor` | string | No | Parameter defines the fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details. |

## Pricing

$0.010 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged.
